scripts.text:
[Warehouse Manager]
How are you? We are specialized in guild warehouses. This is our ^0000cdstory^000000:
Why can't guild members share a storage? We started off with that simple question.
scripts.translation:
[倉庫管理員]
您好。我們專門經營公會倉庫。這是我們的^0000cd故事^000000：
為什麼公會成員不能共享倉庫？我們就是從這樣一個簡單的問題開始的。

scripts.text:
[Warehouse Manager]
You can open the warehouse for 1000 Zeny or look up the usage history of the guild.
How can I help you?
scripts.translation:
[倉庫管理員]
您可以花費1000 Zeny開啟倉庫，或者檢視公會的使用記錄。
請問有什麼可以幫您？

scripts.text:
[Warehouse Manager]
The guild storage is only available for guild members.
scripts.translation:
[倉庫管理員]
公會倉庫僅對公會成員開放。

scripts.text:
[Warehouse Manager]
It seems that it is not yet possible for your guild to use the guild warehouse or you do not have access permissions for the warehouse.
Please come back after checking the guild skill and the permission to access the warehouse.
scripts.translation:
[倉庫管理員]
看起來您的公會目前還無法使用公會倉庫，或者您沒有倉庫的訪問許可權。
請檢查公會技能和倉庫訪問許可權後再來。

scripts.text:
[Warehouse Manager]
I am afraid you do not have enough money to settle the fee.
The fee is 1000 Zeny.
scripts.translation:
[倉庫管理員]
很抱歉，您的Zeny不足以支付費用。
費用是1000 Zeny。

scripts.text:
[Warehouse Manager]
I will open the guild storage for you then. Have a memorable time!
scripts.translation:
[倉庫管理員]
那我就為您開啟公會倉庫吧。祝您使用愉快！

scripts.text:
[Warehouse Manager]
I am afraid someone else is using the warehouse right now.
Please try again after a while.
scripts.translation:
[倉庫管理員]
很抱歉，現在有人正在使用倉庫。
請稍後再試。

scripts.text:
[Warehouse Manager]
The guild storage is only available for guild members.
scripts.translation:
[倉庫管理員]
公會倉庫僅對公會成員開放。

scripts.text:
[Warehouse Manager]
It seems that it is not yet possible for your guild to use the guild warehouse or you do not have access permissions for the warehouse.
Please come back after checking the guild skill and the permission to access the warehouse.
scripts.translation:
[倉庫管理員]
看起來您的公會目前還無法使用公會倉庫，或者您沒有倉庫的訪問許可權。
請檢查公會技能和倉庫訪問許可權後再來。

scripts.text:
[Warehouse Manager]
I will show you the usage history of the warehouse. Usage history will be retained for up to 3 months.
Have a memorable time!
scripts.translation:
[倉庫管理員]
我將向您展示倉庫的使用記錄。使用記錄最多保留3個月。
祝您使用愉快！
